hook: I want global payroll to feel as calm as paying one team

builtFor.context: Rippling runs payroll for employees, EOR hires and contractors around the world in one system. As companies add countries, the hard part isn't calculating pay; it's knowing what's due where, and when.

opportunities.title: Global Pay Calendar
opportunities.body: Every country's approve-by and payday in one view.

opportunities.title: Moved dates, explained
opportunities.body: Local holidays flagged before they cost a payday.

opportunities.title: Funding per currency
opportunities.body: What each currency needs, when, and from where.

body: My work has been in financial products where mistakes cost people money: lending at Shecluded, payments at Foodlify, compliance at Youverify.
I prototype in code with AI tools, which is how I built the concept in this pitch, and I've worked with remote, multi-country teams for years.

bring.title: Complex money flows
bring.body: A 5-step loan flow and dashboard that lifted first-time engagement by 30%.

bring.title: Design systems
bring.body: A component library that cut developer onboarding by 45%.

bring.title: Regulated products
bring.body: KYC and transaction monitoring for financial institutions.

systemsGets: Someone who designs the states of a pay run across countries (draft, needs you, approved, funded, paid) so they read the same everywhere.

opportunity.title: Global Pay Calendar
opportunity.problem: Each country has its own approval window, holidays and currency, so admins piece deadlines together from separate pay runs, and a moved date is easy to miss.
opportunity.solution: One calendar of approve-by and payday for every entity, moved dates explained in place, and a funding plan per currency.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how multi-country admins run payroll today, then contributing one useful improvement with the team.

days.body: Meet Global Payroll product, design and engineering. Learn the roadmap and the markets.
Review late and off-cycle pay runs and support tickets across countries.
Agree on one moment to improve, grounded in evidence.
Prototype it and review edge cases with payroll ops and engineering.
Share findings, the prototype and a test plan with admins.

ask: I'd love to help Rippling make global payroll feel simple at any scale.
